title: LNbits Releases 1.7.0 Urgent Security Update After November 8 Attacks Drain Funds
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

LNbits Releases 1.7.0 Urgent Security Update After November 8 Attacks Drain Funds

LNbits released version 1.7.0 on November 10 as an urgent security update following active attacks that began November 8. Operators must upgrade before restarting servers as prior versions put funds at risk of theft.

This post LNbits Releases 1.7.0 Urgent Security Update After November 8 Attacks Drain Funds first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Juan Galt.

title: Texas Rep. Files Bill Letting Cities Invest $10 Million in Bitcoin
summary:

Texas Rep. Files Bill Letting Cities Invest $10 Million in Bitcoin

Rep. Ron Reynolds filed House Bill 815 on Monday, allowing each Texas city or county to put up to $10 million of public money into bitcoin starting Sept. 1, 2027.

This post Texas Rep. Files Bill Letting Cities Invest $10 Million in Bitcoin first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

title: Poland’s Parliament Votes 240-202 to Let Officials Freeze Crypto Before Court Review
summary:

Poland’s Parliament Votes 240-202 to Let Officials Freeze Crypto Before Court Review

Poland's Sejm passed a sanctions bill Friday that lets the interior minister freeze bitcoin and bank funds of people on a national list, and a court appeal would not pause the freeze.

title: Canaan (CAN) Swings to an $8 Million Profit on Bitcoin Gains as Rig Sales Collapse 96%

title: Binance Warns iOS Flaw Could Expose Wallet Seed Phrases as Apple’s Latest iPhone Patch Stays Silent
summary:

Binance Warns iOS Flaw Could Expose Wallet Seed Phrases as Apple’s Latest iPhone Patch Stays Silent

Binance told iPhone users a public iOS sandbox escape called worse_query could let malicious apps read seed phrases and private keys stored by other apps, while Apple's Nov. 9 updates do not mention the bug.
